EDIT: Thank you po for your answers!

Question for Filipinos who recently went to PH & came back to Israel
Hi everyone! Question po for Filipino spouses here. Has anyone managed to return to Israel without completing the CFO Counseling program first?

Quick background: we're flying to the Philippines on September 17, then heading back to Israel around October. I wanted to finish the CFO Counseling since I know Immigration can ask for it, but CFO requires a Marriage Certificate and Report of Marriage, and I don't have either yet.

We got married on May 4, 2026 through a Utah Zoom marriage, and we're only starting the Report of Marriage process (through the PH Consulate in San Francisco) after our wedding celebration in the Philippines on September 24. So both documents will still be in process by the time we fly back.

Has anyone been in a similar spot? Were any of u able to return to Israel while these documents were still pending? Did Immigration give you any trouble, or were you able to sort it out another way? Would really appreciate any insight po. Thank you! 🙏
